note: Trades are keyed by ROSTER ID, not team name, because managers rename teams mid-season and a renamed team would silently stop matching. Roster ids never change. The names below are only labels for you reading this file -- the site always shows each team's current Sleeper name. Budgets are computed from this list, so the ledger and the numbers can never disagree. Constitution: nobody enters the draft above $225 or below $175, and nobody holds more than two keepers.
